title: lifecycle
summary: Current Benilla defines the session-obligation sends CMSG_PING (sequence + lastRtt), CMSG_LOGOUT_REQUEST/CMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL, CMSG_QUERY_TIME and CMSG_COMPLETE_CINEMATIC. MSUI implements each exact body and its consumer: bounded ping cadence/PONG latency, logout response/cancel/complete, world-entry plus timed-quest server-clock sampling, and immediate ESC-style cinematic completion so the body-centered world stream resumes.
